reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that calculates estimated per-session API costs from local token usage and displays live cost and token breakdowns in the composer.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中根据令牌用量和可配置费率实时估算并显示 API 成本及分类明细。
summaries.en: Estimates and displays real-time per-session API costs and token breakdowns in DeepSeek Harness using configurable rates.

capabilities: Reads provider-reported token usage from the local session log
Calculates estimated API costs using configurable model pricing
Displays live per-session token usage and cost in the composer interface
